You are rebuilding every page of the **Marlowe Club App** template, a app-multi site (angle: fast-app). Keep the section order, the content and every rule in the brief. Write the page text exactly as given (it is in Portuguese); write code and comments in English. If something in the brief is missing or unclear, ask instead of guessing, and never invent claims, figures, offers or reviews.

**Target stack:** WordPress with the SX ACF blocks (`sx/<block>` from `wp/sx-blocks.php`). If you use another stack (plain HTML/CSS, React/Next.js, another CMS), build one component per section with the listed fields as props.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Sections appear in the order given, with the same layout variant (or an equivalent layout).
- [ ] All text is used exactly as given; nothing invented (no extra claims, figures, offers or reviews).
- [ ] One H1 per page; headings do not skip levels.
- [ ] No horizontal scrolling at 375px; tap targets at least 44px.
- [ ] Each page is under 64 KB of HTML and CSS (images excluded).
- [ ] The structured data listed for each page is present and valid.
- [ ] Every internal link opens an existing page.
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA, focus is visible, images have alt text.
- [ ] Every rule in the market guidance and the block rules holds on every page.

# Rebuild brief: Marlowe Club App

_Follow the system prompt (role, target stack, acceptance checklist) together with this brief._

## Site type guidance

- Purpose: the one-page app page as home, plus service pages: iPhone, Android, features, what's new and help.
- The iPhone page shows only App Store buttons; the Android page only Google Play / APK buttons.
- A single-platform site drops the other platform's page and its menu link.
- What's new lists versions from the brand's app data, newest first.
- Store-style looks change the home page into that store listing; the other pages keep the site layout in the store's colours.

## Market guidance

### Market context

- Market: Brazil (`br`), languages pt, currency BRL
- Minimum age: 18+
- Products allowed: sports, casino
- Promotions allowed: none; restricted: welcome_bonus, deposit_bonus, free_bets, promo_code
- Payment methods: pix, ted, debit
- App install paths: iOS app-store, Android both
- Notes: Regulated under Lei 14.790/2023. Licensed operators use .bet.br domains. Advance bonuses are prohibited; PIX is the default payment rail; credit cards are not accepted.

### Mandated texts (from the market settings)

- Age notice: Proibido para menores de 18 anos.
- Self-exclusion: Você pode solicitar a autoexclusão a qualquer momento.

### Rules you must not break

- Every page opens with an age gate (18+) before any gambling content.
- Every page has the responsible-gambling panel (usually in the footer) with the market text: age notice, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion and helpline where given. Never type this text yourself; it comes from the market settings.
- Only licensed operators with .bet.br domains; links go to the .bet.br domain.
- Payments are PIX, TED and debit cards; never show credit cards.
- Identity and age are verified with CPF before play.

## Site context

- Site: Marlowe Club App (https://app.marlowe.example), brand or publisher: Marlowe Club
- Site type: app-multi, angle fast-app; language `pt`, text direction `ltr`
- Pages (6):
  - `index.html` — Baixe o app Marlowe Club para iPhone e Android
  - `iphone.html` — Marlowe Club no iPhone: instale pela App Store
  - `android.html` — Marlowe Club no Android: Google Play ou APK
  - `features.html` — Recursos do app Marlowe Club
  - `whats-new.html` — Novidades do app Marlowe Club
  - `help.html` — Ajuda do app Marlowe Club: instalação, login e atualizações

## Design tokens

Fonts (Google Fonts): PT Sans, PT Serif.

Layout is mobile-first: it must work from 375px to 1440px wide.

## Block rules

- Header: One-page landing and app pages use 'minimal' (no nav) so attention stays on the conversion.
- Header: The CTA stays visible at every width; on mobile the nav collapses into a menu, the CTA does not.
- App hero: Install buttons above the fold at 375x667; the visitor's platform first.
- App hero: Facts (version, size, age rating) come from brands/<brand>.app, never from content.
- App hero: Store-listing structure only: no imitation of App Store or Google Play interface.
- Trust bar: Values come from brand facts and market config; nothing is typed by hand.
- Trust bar: Rating shows only when the brand has facts.rating_source.
- Trust bar: Sits directly under the hero (section 2 or 3).
- Screenshots: 3-6 screens, captions 6 words max, each caption names one benefit.
- Screenshots: Real screenshots must be the brand's own, 9:19.5, WebP or AVIF.
- Features: 3 or 4 items. Titles 4 words max, text one sentence (about 120 characters).
- Features: Features describe the product, never an offer or bonus.
- Install guide: Required on any site that offers an APK (blueprint rule 'apk').
- Install guide: The APK column always shows the file size, version and the distribution note: why it is outside Google Play and that Android will warn.
- Install guide: Default steps are UI strings in every locale; content may override them per platform.
- App info: Every value comes from brands/<brand>.app and the market; nothing is typed per site.
- FAQ: 4-6 questions: legality in the country, deposits/withdrawals, payout time, verification, limits or self-exclusion.
- FAQ: Answers are plain text, 1-3 sentences. No CTA links inside answers.
- Download panel: Always the last section before the footer on app pages.
- Download panel: QR encodes links.qr (a device-aware tracked link) or links.go; generated at build time, no external service.
- Download panel: QR shows on desktop only; phones get the buttons.
- Footer: Always renders the compliance panel; it cannot be switched off.
- Footer: Payment methods come from the market config so they are always locally correct.
- Responsible gambling: All copy comes from markets/<id>.json; never type compliance text into a page.
- Responsible gambling: Every page renders a 'panel' (usually inside the footer). 'strip' is an optional top-of-page addition.
- Responsible gambling: Where a market lists several mandated taglines, one is chosen per site by seed.
- Age gate: Age comes from the market (21 in KZ, 18 in AU/BR). Never hard-code it.
- Age gate: Content stays in the HTML for crawlers; the overlay is shown by script, so no-JS users still see the compliance footer.
- Sticky CTA: Phones only (860px and narrower). Never covers the compliance panel: the footer gets bottom padding.
- Sticky CTA: Shows the market age badge next to the CTA.
- Page title: The answer line states the page's key fact in one sentence, above the fold on phones.
- Steps: Exactly 3 steps; numbers are used because the order is real.
- Steps: Mention verification and deposit limits honestly; do not promise instant approval.
- Page links: Internal links only; never a substitute for the brand CTA.
- Text block: Only h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, a, table, blockquote survive; all attributes except href are removed.
- Text block: Links: page:<id> for internal pages, https:// for sources. Brand links belong in CTAs, not in prose.
- What's new: Renders nothing (and warns) if the brand has no changelog for the site's locale.

## Page `index.html`

- Title tag: Baixe o app Marlowe Club para iPhone e Android
- The only H1: Baixe o app Marlowe Club
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, MobileApplication, FAQPage, WebSite
- Links to: `index.html`, `iphone.html`, `android.html`, `features.html`, `whats-new.html`, `help.html`

### Sections, in order

1. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `inline`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: true
2. **App hero** — block `sx/app-hero`, variant `qr-first`, role `hero`
   Purpose: App download hero: icon, name, developer, fact row, install buttons for the visitor's device, phone.
   - `title`: "Baixe o app Marlowe Club"
   - `subtitle`: "Mesas ao vivo, depósitos e saques via PIX em até 30 minutos, direto no celular."
   - `screen`: "table"
3. **Trust bar** — block `sx/trust-bar`, variant `strip`, role `trust`
   Purpose: Licence, payout time, years operating, local payments and (only if sourced) rating.
   - `items`: `["licence","payout","since","payments"]`
4. **Screenshots** — block `sx/screenshots`, variant `grid`, role `content`
   Purpose: Phone screens with one-line captions. Real screenshots via image URLs; CSS-drawn screens otherwise.
   - `eyebrow`: "No app"
   - `title`: "Feito para jogar no celular"
   - `screens`: `[{"kind":"table","caption":"Mesas ao vivo em HD"},{"kind":"casino","caption":"Mais de 2.400 jogos"},{"kind":"wallet","caption":"Depósito e saque via PIX"},{"kind":"slip","caption":"Histórico de apostas"}]`
5. **Features** — block `sx/features`, variant `bento`, role `content`
   Purpose: 3-4 product reasons to join, each with an icon, a short title and one sentence.
   - `eyebrow`: "Pagamentos rápidos"
   - `title`: "Seu dinheiro na hora, no app"
   - `items`: `[{"icon":"wallet","title":"PIX em segundos","text":"Depósitos via PIX aprovados na hora, sem sair do app."},{"icon":"bolt","title":"Saque em até 30 min","text":"A maioria dos saques via PIX cai na conta em até meia hora."},{"icon":"shield","title":"Autorizada no Brasil","text":"Operação autorizada pela SPA/MF, no domínio .bet.br."},{"icon":"gauge","title":"Limites no app","text":"Defina limites de depósito e pausas no seu perfil."}]`
6. **Install guide** — block `sx/install-guide`, variant `tabs`, role `content`
   Purpose: Step-by-step install per platform (iPhone, Google Play, APK), each ending in its install button.
   - `eyebrow`: "Instalação"
   - `title`: "Como instalar o app"
7. **App info** — block `sx/app-info`, variant `chips`, role `content`
   Purpose: Version, size, requirements, languages, age rating, developer, licence. All from brand app data.
8. **FAQ** — block `sx/faq`, variant `accordion`, role `content`
   Purpose: Answers the objections that stop sign-ups. Emits FAQPage structured data.
   - `items`: `[{"q":"O app é gratuito?","a":"Sim. O app é gratuito na App Store, na Google Play e como APK nesta página."},{"q":"Posso instalar no Android sem a Google Play?","a":"Sim. Além da Google Play, você pode baixar o APK oficial nesta página. O Android mostrará um aviso, o que é normal para apps fora da loja."},{"q":"Quais formas de pagamento o app aceita?","a":"PIX, TED e cartão de débito. Cartão de crédito não é aceito, conforme a regulamentação brasileira."},{"q":"Preciso verificar minha conta?","a":"Sim. A lei exige verificação de identidade e idade com CPF antes de jogar."}]`
9. **Download panel** — block `sx/download-panel`, variant `panel`, role `content`
   Purpose: Final install section: all install buttons, a QR code for desktop visitors, key app facts.
   - `title`: "Baixe o Marlowe Club"
   - `text`: "Grátis para iPhone e Android. 18+."
10. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `compact`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `cards`
     - `show_verify`: false
11. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `fullscreen`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false
12. **Sticky CTA** — block `sx/sticky-cta`, variant `app-banner`, role `sticky`
   Purpose: Bottom CTA on phones. Appears once the hero CTA scrolls away; hides while the final CTA is on screen.

   - `limit`: "0"
4. **Text block** — block `sx/prose`, variant `article`, role `content`
   Purpose: Formats a service page's text: H2/H3, paragraphs, lists, a simple table. Optional table of contents. Content comes from the content pipeline.
   - `html`: `<h2>Como manter o app atualizado</h2><p>Na App Store e na Google Play as atualizações chegam sozinhas quando a atualização automática está ativa. Quem usa o APK recebe um aviso no app quando há uma versão nova; basta instalar por cima, sem perder a conta.
